options.title: The Las Vegas Strip keeps {min_per_part} every minute 🎰
options.first_line: The Las Vegas Strip keeps {min_per_part} from gamblers every single minute.
options.first_frame: The neon Las Vegas Strip at night; a giant slot machine in front of the casinos spins, and its jackpot screen reads the per-minute figure as a clock's second hand sweeps beside it.

options.title: Las Vegas casinos kept {day_total} in 2025, after paying every winner
options.first_line: The Las Vegas Strip's casinos kept {day_total} from gamblers in 2025, after paying every winner.
options.first_frame: The famous Welcome to Las Vegas sign at night with a scoreboard bolted on top reading the year's total, a winner below throwing chips in the air.

options.title: Las Vegas keeps {hour_per_part} an hour, even when you win
options.first_line: Every hour, the Las Vegas Strip keeps {hour_per_part}, even on nights people win.
options.first_frame: A roulette wheel spinning on a casino table under neon, the ball landing on red as a gambler cheers, while a rack of chips worth the hourly figure slides to the house.

why: It names the Las Vegas Strip and a startling per-minute take in the first words, and its first frame (a jackpot screen showing the figure beside a sweeping second hand) says it all with the sound off.
